title: Fitness & Exercise Equipment
painPoint: Fitness equipment manufacturers face critical challenges with magnetic resistance systems and BLDC drive motors. High-end exercise bikes and ellipticals demand consistent, smooth resistance curves across intensity levels, requiring NdFeB magnets with tight flux density tolerances. Eddy current resistance units suffer performance degradation when magnets lose strength at elevated operating temperatures during prolonged high-intensity sessions. Treadmill BLDC motors need N42SH and N38SH grades to maintain torque output while resisting demagnetization under continuous load. Corrosion from sweat and humidity environments attacks unprotected magnet surfaces, causing irreversible flux loss. Achieving whisper-quiet operation demands precise magnetic circuit geometry to minimize cogging torque and vibration.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers precision-engineered NdFeB magnets tailored for fitness and exercise equipment applications. Our N42SH and N45SH grades maintain stable magnetic flux at elevated temperatures, ensuring consistent resistance profiles across extended workout sessions. For treadmill and elliptical BLDC motors, our N38UH and N35EH grades provide superior temperature stability with high coercivity, preventing demagnetization under sustained high-current operation. Every magnet receives multilayer Ni-Cu-Ni or epoxy coating for salt-spray and humidity corrosion resistance, critical for gym and home fitness environments. We maintain tight dimensional tolerances and flux uniformity to minimize cogging torque and vibration noise.
